messages:
Alex (Sales): Quick handoff for Rivermoss — mid‑market, signed 2024-06-01, 12mo. Running on a dedicated trial in us‑west. Onboarding ~60%. Two blockers: SSO failing (Okta cert/tls) and batch CSV ingest returning 5xx. Renewal date 2025-10-01; flagging medium risk until infra + enablement complete.

Maria (CS): I'll own onboarding + enablement. Need Sam/Carla contact, sample logs, and a slot to run enablement (Wed 09:00 PT?). Also they want a short walkthrough of routing & cost controls.

Alex (Sales): Contacts: sam@rivermoss.com (Platform lead), carla@rivermoss.com (PM). Sam OKs scoped log/metadata upload to shared drive. I'll intro them now.

Jon (Eng): Reproduced Okta error: "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority" when calling IdP. Opening ENG-7892. Fix is config change requiring a restart of rivermoss-dedicated-01. Need IdP metadata XML or cert from customer.

Lisa (Support): Creating SUPPORT-3421 and a synthetic monitor for ingest endpoint. Alert: page oncall + Jon if 5xx rate >1% over 5m.

infra-bot: Maintenance request queued for rivermoss-dedicated-01. Queue pos: 3. Please confirm ETA in ENG-7892.

Alex (Sales): Sam replied: uploading IdP metadata + sanitized CSV. Preferred maintenance Tue 15:00-16:00 PT and requests 30m pre-call.

Maria (CS): I'll schedule Tue 14:30 PT pre-call and Wed 09:00 PT enablement. I'll make a short feedback doc to capture concerns and action items.

Jon (Eng): I can do restart Tue 15:10 PT after pre-call. Will apply config and monitor health. I'll update ENG-7892 with PR and health checks.

Lisa (Support): I'll monitor during restart and escalate if 5xx spikes. SUPPORT-3421 assigned to me + Jon for 48h.

Maria (CS): Owners recap: Maria = onboarding/enablement + feedback capture; Jon = ENG-7892 Okta & restart; Lisa = SUPPORT-3421 + monitors; Alex = customer liaison + CRM renewal flagging. I'll create CS-1220 epic and link tickets.

Alex (Sales): Renewal set to "monitoring" in CRM, follow-up in 30 days on adoption metrics. Use this thread for quick updates. :thumbsup:
